name: Zähringen Family
description: Noble family of the Alps who began the craze of founding new towns to consolidate their lands into a continuous bloc and serve as points of military strength.

name: Kiburg Family
description: Noble family of the Alps, rival of the Zähringers, which followed a similar policy of founding towns.

name: House of Savoy
description: Noble family of Savoy, rival of the Zähringers, which also founded new towns to attract settlers.

name: Hapsburg Family
description: Noble family, rival of the Zähringers, which followed a policy of founding new towns.

name: Landfriedensbund
description: Temporary regional peace alliances encouraged by German nobles, designed to keep the peace by developing processes of law instead of military feuds; they pave the way for later eternal alliances.

name: Town Foundation
description: The practice of counts declaring villages to be towns, granting privileges and tax exemptions to attract settlers; a craze in full swing in 1220.
